description.value: Van Tea Cafe is a Hong Kong-style Chinese restaurant in Richmond offering dishes including fried chicken, laksa, and seafood prepared from fresh ingredients. The Richmond location features a large dining hall with a broad menu of Chinese comfort food. A second location operates in Vancouver on Main Street.
